author: JoeVC
body:
Well, to start it off, i'm an idiot to say the least, i tried to cheat the system for my own benefit thinking i could do what many others couldn't, and that is to get away with cheating. I 100% deserve the ban and i 100% agree with the ban; I am not writing this out of pity for myself, although it might sound that way. 

I admitted to cheating straight away, i am not proud that i used an auto clicker, i have been told by some mods that i was suspected of cheating for some times, and they are most likely right, i downloaded the auto clicker about 4 weeks ago, in the hope that i could become a better player, and maybe join Apollo - pretty sad right. I wanted to become a better player, and therefore play with better players, but i did not have the patience or integrity to develop my skills in a way which the majority of better players have done, i decided to cheat, i let the belief that joining a team was important than the trust bestowed upon me by members of the community who i had managed to befriend. That's the worst of it, I feel bad the for the community, the players like Zedther, Loki and Buster, who i became such good friends with and they would genuinely comment on PvP ability, and for them just to find out that i cheat. It seriously pulls on my heart strings. 

Since being banned i have uninstalled the auto clicker, i have thought about my actions and realised how idiotic it was to try and uphold the etiquette and values that Avicus has to offer as a Referee, but in reality being a Hypocrite of what i preached. I do not write this for pity, but i do hope that you would find it somewhere in your hearts to see from my point of view, and maybe feel how i would feel if you were in my position. 

I know that the majority of ban appeals are left for 2-3 months before even being considered, but i say this from the bottom of my heart, i have never been so stupid to think i could outsmart a server of such status, even 2 days after my ban i am feeling the affects of my punishment; the worst being what people must think of me, and i hope you will take this into consideration when deciding on the outcome of my appeal. 

Best Regards,
Joe

title: Ban Appeal - Iosephus

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Joe,

I don't feel bad, nor show mercy to cheaters. You're staying banned for at least 3-6 months. 

Appeal in that time frame, all appeals prior will be denied.

This appeal is denied.
